format: char-map txt: '# frame N MSms' blocks, '.' transparent; PNGs are 1x RGBA

conventions.coords: pixels from the top-left of the effect frame; pivot sits on the attach point
conventions.facing: all drawn facing E; for W flip x (pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of offsets/arc_*, cell_offset_x -> 127-x)
conventions.cell: 96 px figure in a 128x128 cell (v2/pixelize/top1), feet pivot (64,124) = soles/ground row 124; cell_offset = where the pivot goes in that cell for the reference pose (SE master EC0_SE_96)
conventions.from_48: redrawn at 2x with 1 px detail from v2/fx (48 px); old cell_offset (x,y) ~ new (64+2(x-32), 124+2(y-62))

functions.afterimage: tools/fxlib.py afterimage(rgba, light=a, dark=A, alpha in {1,.75,.5,.25}, mode 2tone|1tone, rim=1): flat ghost of any frame
functions.afterimage_trail: tools/fxlib.py afterimage_trail(rgba, step=10, n=3, dx=-1, alphas=(.75,.5,.25)): 3 ghosts 10 px apart (96 px scale) behind the motion, returns (canvas, origin_x); live frame on top, speed lines behind
functions.whiteflash: tools/fxlib.py whiteflash(rgba): 1-frame damage flash, all opaque px -> w #f8f8f8, near-black outline (K/X) kept

throw.note: THROW group (v2/throw): orb held in hand.R until the release key, then spawned at frames.json ball.spawn_px with ball.vel_dir_px (v2/hy3d/frames_mocap/throw_<dir>/s48 (x2 for 96 px until an s96 exists)/frames.json); throw_trail + throw_sparkle on the release key at the hand (E-drawn; flip x for W; other views: rotate/skip per frames.json); orb spins (throw_orb loop) in flight; throw_pop at the landing point (game code).
throw.source: hand-pixelled by Opus (fx/work/throw/), char-maps in maps/

throw_orb.mirror: flip x for W-facing: x -> w-1-x, pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of offsets/velocity, cell_offset_x -> 127-x (spin then runs backwards, acceptable)
throw_orb.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), ground row 124; throw-pose release hand = s48 throw_E frames.json (hy3d/frames_G) frame 3 'release' hand.R x2 -> (111,69), used as (110,70); this is NOT the idle hand (~(81,84)); stride hand (frame 2) ~(63,66); cell_offset = orb at the release hand
throw_orb.spawn: spawn at the release hand (110,70) on the release frame, then move by flight_per_unit
throw_orb.outline: K 1 px all round (13 px circle: runs 5/2/1x2/5 per octant)
throw_orb.note: red top r with fixed 3 px w highlight top-left and x shade crescent right; 2-row j band (rows 6-7 mid, rows 5-6 at the edges: bows down 1 px so the equator reads as seen from above); white bottom w with v down both the left edge and the lower-right crescent; button = 3x2 w/v face in a full j ring (pokes 1 px above/below the band), foreshortened 2x2 at the sides; it travels L->R while highlight/shading stay fixed

throw_trail.mirror: flip x for W-facing: x -> w-1-x, pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of offsets/velocity, cell_offset_x -> 127-x
throw_trail.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), ground row 124; throw-pose release hand = s48 throw_E frames.json (hy3d/frames_G) frame 3 'release' hand.R x2 -> (111,69), used as (110,70); this is NOT the idle hand (~(81,84)); stride hand (frame 2) ~(63,66); cell_offset = release hand; canvas at cell (61,46)-(112,73)
throw_trail.arc_note: [dx,dy] from pivot; pivot = the rounded tip at the release hand (trail start for the orb); arc_start = 1 px tail tip behind the head (~stride hand), arc_top = apex above the head
throw_trail.note: circular arc (outer edge centre (23.75,30.96) r 28.5); thickness: 1 px n tail for the first ~12 px, smoothstep up to 10 px at 70% of the arc, cos taper to a rounded 2 px tip at the hand; along: n -> p -> w with slanted colour boundaries; across: 1 px n inner rim, 1 px p, w body

throw_sparkle.mirror: flip x for W-facing: x -> w-1-x, pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of offsets/velocity, cell_offset_x -> 127-x (symmetric, flip is a no-op; the 1 px diagonal glints swap sides, fine)
throw_sparkle.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), ground row 124; throw-pose release hand = s48 throw_E frames.json (hy3d/frames_G) frame 3 'release' hand.R x2 -> (111,69), used as (110,70); this is NOT the idle hand (~(81,84)); stride hand (frame 2) ~(63,66); cell_offset = release hand

throw_pop.mirror: flip x for W-facing: x -> w-1-x, pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of offsets/velocity, cell_offset_x -> 127-x (f0/f1 ring symmetric)
throw_pop.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), ground row 124; throw-pose release hand = s48 throw_E frames.json (hy3d/frames_G) frame 3 'release' hand.R x2 -> (111,69), used as (110,70); this is NOT the idle hand (~(81,84)); stride hand (frame 2) ~(63,66); cell_offset (100,118) = EXAMPLE landing spot on the floor ~36 px in front of her (clear of the legs); game code uses the real landing point of the orb
throw_pop.burst_note: burst centre = orb centre, 6.5 px above the ground pivot (orb radius)

hit_spark.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; head top ~(64,29) (bow x60-66 y29-33), head ~x50-80 y29-60, chest ~y70-80; default hit_point = target body_centre (63,76) (torso centre on the obi; r2, was (64,88) on the skirt)
hit_spark.mirror: flip x for W-facing: x -> 29-x, pivot_x -> 15, cell_offset_x -> 127-x
hit_spark.core_px: 2x2 centre at (14..15,14..15); pivot = upper-left of it; 4-fold rotationally symmetric about (14.5,14.5)
hit_spark.note: r2: single 1 px core/rim/rays (no doubled bands), ring broken into angular arcs, ~20% smaller (36 -> 30). same timing. gen work/B/make_r2.py

hit_flash.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; head top ~(64,29) (bow x60-66 y29-33), head ~x50-80 y29-60, chest ~y70-80; default hit_point = target body_centre (63,76) (torso centre on the obi; r2, was (64,88) on the skirt)
hit_flash.note: hard 8-point star, 8-fold symmetric, 3 values w/y/f, no outline. f0 on the hit-stop frame (pair with fxlib.whiteflash() on the target sprite), f1 = burst dispersing; then hit_spark. gen work/B/make_r2.py

speed_lines_long.note: 6 streaks, all 1 px tall, lengths 12-46, uneven spacing (gaps 16/4/6/10/5) clustered at chest (68-78) and hip (88-93) plus one high line at the shoulders; w head ~30%, p ~35%, n tail with a 1 px break. f0 heads end 2 px inside the back K edge; f1 shifted back 3-6 px and re-lengthed. Pivot outside the canvas (canvas top-left = cell (9,52)).
speed_lines_long.with_afterimage: with afterimage_trail(step=10, n=3): add [-30,0] to cell_offset so the heads meet the oldest ghost; draw the lines behind the ghosts and clip them to outside the ghost/figure alpha (demo work/dash_test.png)
speed_lines_long.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure EC0_SE_96, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; body centre (63,76) (chest ~y70-80); ground_y = cell row 124 (sole row)

speed_lines_short.note: 5 short streaks, all 1 px tall, lengths 8-22, clustered at chest (69-79) and hip (88-92); same colour split as the long set, no afterimage-hue pixels. f1 shifted back 3-5 px. Pivot outside the canvas (canvas top-left = cell (31,69)).
speed_lines_short.with_afterimage: with afterimage_trail(step=10, n=3): add [-30,0] to cell_offset so the heads meet the oldest ghost; draw the lines behind the ghosts and clip them to outside the ghost/figure alpha (demo work/dash_test.png)
speed_lines_short.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure EC0_SE_96, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; body centre (63,76) (chest ~y70-80); ground_y = cell row 124 (sole row)

dust_step.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; back boot x58-64 sole row 124 (back heel x58), front boot x66-74; ground_y = cell row 124; pivot = ground point
dust_step.mirror: flip x: x -> 27-x, pivot -> [5,27]; re-run work/gen_dust2.py with mirrored lobes so the U sel-out rim stays top-left (do not flip pixels)
dust_step.note: r2: one billowing mass per frame, lobes graded 12/9/6 px from the heel outward and rising up/back; flat G base on ground row 27 (f0,f1); only short t creases at lobe notches; sel-out outline U on lit top-left, G bottom/right. f2 detached, lifted 14 px + fleck. work/gen_dust2.py.

dust_land.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; back boot x58-64 sole row 124 (back heel x58), front boot x66-74; ground_y = cell row 124; pivot = ground point
dust_land.mirror: symmetric; no flip needed (geometry mirrored, light top-left on both sides)
dust_land.note: r2: pivot x34 = first column right of centre line. Each side one billow: big lobe at the feet -> 9/6 px lobes outward, outer lobes lifted 2 px on later frames; flat G base on row 19 (f0-f2), f3 floats; U sel-out rim top-left, G bottom/right. work/gen_dust2.py.

dust_skid.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; back boot x58-64 sole row 124 (back heel x58), front boot x66-74; ground_y = cell row 124; pivot = ground point
dust_skid.mirror: flip x: x -> 53-x, pivot -> [0,21]; re-run work/gen_dust2.py mirrored so the U rim stays top-left
dust_skid.note: r2: low streaky smear (merged ellipses + horizontal t streaks), tallest at the heel (pivot, cell 60,124), tapering/shrinking toward the back with a flat G base; f2 heel mass stays, tail breaks into lifted wisps. work/gen_dust2.py.

jump_whoosh.mirror: symmetric about the pivot column; no flip needed
jump_whoosh.note: ground-anchored at the take-off point (pivot = boot centre cell x66 on the sole row 124). A flat perspective U: the bottom run sits 1-3 rows below the soles (runs 15/3/2/1/1 per side), the sides rise 16 px beside the boots (cell x50/82, 8 px clear) and flare 3 px outward at the tips (an upward rush). Stroke tapers 3 px (w,w inside, u outer rim) along the bottom -> 2 px (w,u) up the lower sides -> 1 px u tips. f1: risen 6 px, max 2 px thick, cut by rows into 3 pieces (bottom rows 28-31, side 18-25, tip 8-15 before the rise).
jump_whoosh.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure EC0_SE_96, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; body centre (63,76) (chest ~y70-80); ground_y = cell row 124 (sole row)

layer_split.why: back arc passes behind the boots, centre row + front arc in front

land_ring.note: pivot = ellipse centre = ground point (cell 66,124 = boot centre on the sole row). 1 px ring with hand-picked even side runs (f0 15/4/3/2/1, f1 19/6/4/3/2/2/1, f2 19/6/5/3/3/2/1 + 3-row ends); back (upper) arc p, front arc w, centre-row ends and the outer 3-4 px of the front arc u. f0/f1: front run doubled (2 px w) and the next run underlined with u for perspective weight. f2: 4 dashes (back-left/right p, front-left/right w->u), gaps at top centre, bottom centre and both ends. Canvas bottom reaches cell row 134: do not clip effects to the cell.
land_ring.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure EC0_SE_96, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; body centre (63,76) (chest ~y70-80); ground_y = cell row 124 (sole row)

hurt_star.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; head top ~(64,29) (bow x60-66 y29-33), head ~x50-80 y29-60, chest ~y70-80; default hit_point = target body_centre (64,88) (old (32,44) mapped); canvas top-left sits at cell (29,0)
hurt_star.mirror: flip x: x -> 69-x, pivot -> [34,29] (stars swap sides, fine)

orbit.note: flattened, lowered orbit; depth from size; front star bottoms at canvas row 25 = cell y25, 4 px above the head top / bow (y29)

hurt_star.shading: 3-tone: y fill, f on the lower-right third of each star (pixels with dx+dy >= ~R/3 from centre), 2 px w dot top-left (1 px on the back sparkle); every star K outlined
hurt_star.loop: cycle f0,f1 for dizzy (reads as a 60 deg orbit step)
hurt_star.note: r2: f lower-right volume + w dot; width kept ~2x old. gen work/B/make_r2.py

sweat_drop.cell: 128x128 cell, 96 px figure, feet pivot (64,124), faces SE; head top ~(64,29) (bow x60-66 y29-33), head ~x50-80 y29-60, chest ~y70-80; default hit_point = target body_centre (64,88) (old (32,44) mapped); pivot = drop tip on f0; drop body just outside the front (right) hair outline (x~79 at y45)
sweat_drop.mirror: flip x: x -> 10-x, pivot -> [5,0], offset_from_head_top -> [-20,7], cell_offset -> [44,36]
sweat_drop.note: r2: teardrop not cone (belly swells, round bottom). gen work/B/make_r2.py
